# cycle_stack_build (Resource)

Manages a Cycle stack build (`/v1/stacks/{id}/builds`). Builds are create-only: changing any user-configured field forces a new build. After create, the provider polls until the build reaches a terminal state (`live` or `deleted`). This resource does not trigger a deploy; use a pipeline for deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cycle_stack" "demo" {
  name = "Demo"

  source = {
    raw = jsonencode({
      version = "1.0"
      containers = {
        web = {
          name = "web"
          image = {
            name = "nginx"
            origin = {
              type = "docker-hub"
              details = {
                target = "nginx:alpine"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    })
  }
}

# Builds are create-only. Changing about or instructions forces a new build.
# The provider waits until the build is live and does not deploy it.
resource "cycle_stack_build" "v1" {
  stack_id = cycle_stack.demo.id

  about = {
    description = "Initial build"
    version     = "1.0.0"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stack_id` (String) The ID of the stack to build. Changing this forces a new stack build to be created.

### Optional

- `about` (Attributes) Optional metadata describing this build. Changing this forces a new stack build to be created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--about))
- `instructions` (Attributes) Additional instructions used when generating this stack build (git pin and/or build-time variables). Changing this forces a new stack build to be created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instructions))

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this stack build belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the stack build.
- `state` (String) The current state of the stack build (e.g. `new`, `building`, `live`).

<a id="nestedatt--about"></a>
### Nested Schema for `about`

Optional:

- `description` (String) A user-defined description for the build. Changing this forces a new stack build to be created.
- `version` (String) A user-defined version string for the build. Changing this forces a new stack build to be created.


<a id="nestedatt--instructions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instructions`

Optional:

- `git` (Attributes) Pin the build to a specific git branch, tag, or commit hash. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instructions--git))
- `variables` (Map of String) Custom variables applied to the stack during this build. Anywhere the stack uses `{{variable}}`, the matching key is substituted.

<a id="nestedatt--instructions--git"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instructions.git`

Required:

- `type` (String) The type of git information being passed: `branch`, `tag`, or `hash`.
- `value` (String) The branch name, tag name, or commit hash matching `type`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Stack builds are imported using the composite ID "stack_id/build_id".
terraform import cycle_stack_build.v1 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21/651f0a88c53f7b6e2c5aa310
```
